- `GET /v2/devices` now returns virtual devices, such as Android emulators and iOS simulators, in a new `virtual_devices` list. Previously, the response included only private and cloud devices, so virtual devices were available only through `GET /v1/devices`. The same filters and team scoping that apply to `private_devices` also apply to `virtual_devices`. The list is empty for accounts without access to virtual devices. Existing response fields are unchanged.
